error_bar_note: Wilson 95% score intervals; asymmetric, drawn as true [low, high] bounds (not a symmetric approximation) since this is hand-written matplotlib rather than the generator's single-magnitude 'errors' key. Not reported (and not drawn) for the two exploratory E3 replication groups, matching results/e3_replicate.json, which gives pooled shares there but no per-arm Wilson interval.
deviations_from_draft_caption: aspect rendered at 2:1, not the draft's 21:9. Verified against the catalogue generator itself: chart_gen.py's own 'bar' type, given these exact category and series label strings at 21:9 (height 2.79in) -- and even at 4:3/1:1 -- refuses with 'constrained layout could not place this figure... labels, legend and tick marks need more than that leaves for the data'. A full-sentence 4-entry legend plus this y-axis label do not fit a figure this short at 6.5in width; 2:1 (height 3.25in) is the shortest tested aspect at which the real render (with group-effect annotations too) passes assert_text_is_legible with no collisions.
